summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026 announcing a special dividend of $0.90 per common share. Shareholders can choose cash or stock, with stock valued at the 20-day VWAP of $3.8821 per share. Record date is May 4, 2026; payment is June 5, 2026. The company reserves the right to pay entirely in cash. This is a capital return to shareholders, not a tender offer. Watch for shareholder election decisions and potential tax implications.
